# replica-skill

Vendored from [Jakeschincariol/replica-skill](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/replica-skill) at commit `77c9436fb3d18c3d58169efb8caf4fe906b0dc51` (v1.0, “The Replica skill: 11 Claude skills”).

License: MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 Jake Schincariol. See `LICENSE`.

This folder keeps the eleven `SKILL.md` files and the standard-library tools used while authoring the demo: `parity.py`, `imgdiff.py`, `reviews.py`, `themes.json`, `sweep.py`, and `contrast.py`. They are not imported by the running app.

The upstream `themes.json` is unchanged. The timer-specific theme file used for this study is `replica/themes.json`.
